newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Salomon downgrades steel maker Arbed.
newsitem.headline: Salomon downgrades steel maker Arbed.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said on Thursday it had downgraded Luxembourg steel maker Arbed to underperform from hold.
"We are downgrading our estimates to show a net loss of over 1.3 billion Luxembourg francs for 1996 and a net profit of 350 million for 1997," it said in a reseach note.
Salomon Brothers said that on this basis Arbed would continue to undermine shareholder value substantially.
"We believe the market continues to overvalue the restructuring story at Arbed...the stock will eventually relect a more realistic outlook," it said.
Arbed was down 20 francs to 3,430 francs at 1130 GMT on the Brussels bourse.
